features.name: Wrath of the Storm
features.desc: As a Reaction when you are hit by an attacker within 5 feet, you deal 2d8 Thunder or Lightning damage to the attacker (Proficiency Bonus uses per Long Rest).

features.name: Thunderous Strike
features.desc: When you deal Thunder or Lightning damage, you push a target of Large size or smaller 10 feet away.

features.name: Stormborn
features.desc: When you take damage, you can use your Reaction to fly up to 60 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks.
